messages:
Mira: Heads up — new exploited-in-the-wild 0-day: CVE-2026-12345 in commons-fileparser (parser-core 2.3.1). Snyk + runtime telemetry show exploit attempts against /ingest. @security-oncall @Alex_K

Alex_K: Ack. Which services are pulling 2.3.1? I'll run a quick dependency query across monorepo and images.

Irene: llm-ingest, batch-preprocessor, and plugin-adapters (the latter used by dedicated nodes). I already see parser-core:2.3.1 in a couple of Docker layers.

SamR: Exploit vector looks like crafted multipart payload leading to deserialization RCE. Confirmed PoC matches our stack.

Mira: Immediate mitigations (do not wait):
- WAF block rule for multipart/form-data to /ingest endpoints (deny suspicious Content-Disposition patterns).
- Hotpatch images to parser-core 2.3.2 or apply shaded jar workaround.
- Add JVM sandbox flags for ingestion service (limit classloading).
- Rotate KMS service keys used by ingestion role and force re-issue of short-lived tokens.
- Enable detailed audit logging on /ingest and forward to sec index for 72h.

Irene: On it — applying WAF rule now.

Irene: ```bash
# emergency WAF rule
curl -X POST $WAF_API/rules -H 'Authorization: Bearer $WAF_TOKEN' -d '{"match": "/ingest", "content_type": "multipart/form-data", "action": "block", "reason": "CVE-2026-12345 emergency"}'
```

deploy-bot: [deploy] starting rolling restart for llm-ingest:tag=hotfix-cve-2026-12345 -> 1/4 nodes updated

Alex_K: Opening PR to bump parser-core to 2.3.2 + SBOM update, and to pin transitive deps. CI build triggered, ETA ~20m for green image.

security-oncall: Enabling audit logs on /ingest and creating a temporary splunk sourcetype sec-cve-176365. Will set alerts for suspicious classloader calls and spikes in 500s.

SamR: Question on KMS rotation: rotate envelope/data keys or service account keys? We store ingestion artifacts encrypted with envelope keys.

Mira: Rotate both: rotate the service account credentials (to invalidate any leaked long-lived tokens) and rotate envelope KMS keys for the ingest bucket. Mark rotation as emergency and keep old key for 24h for graceful decrypt fallback, but audit all decrypt requests against old key.

Alex_K: CI images built, pushing hotfix images to staging. Will tag canary and run smoke tests then promote.

deploy-bot: [deploy] llm-ingest hotfix promoted: 3/4 nodes updated, canary passed smoke tests

Irene: WAF rule in place, blocking ~120 requests in the last 10m that matched exploit pattern. Logging captures payload hashes. Saving payloads to sec-sandbox for offline analysis.

partnerships-bot: Notifying partners using plugin-adapters pinned to 2.3.1. Draft of customer comms in #partnerships-distro for review.

security-oncall: Draft incident doc: impact = possible RCE attempt, affected services = llm-ingest, batch-preprocessor, plugin-adapters; remediation = WAF block, hotpatch to 2.3.2, KMS rotation, audit logs. Postmortem timeline will be collected.

SamR: Adding a temporary runtime guard in plugin-adapters to reject multipart payloads > 1MB or with unexpected headers. Will ship as quick patch.

Mira: Owners/action items:
- WAF rule: Irene (done)
- Hotpatch images + PR: Alex_K (PR open, CI green)
- KMS/service key rotation: security-oncall (in progress)
- Audit logs/alerts: security-oncall (in progress)
- Partner/customer comms: partnerships-bot & Alex_K
- Forensic payload analysis: SamR

Mira: Standup in 30m in #incident-176365 to review telemetry and confirm full rollout. Keep this thread updated with any new detections. :warning:

Alex_K: Will run an org-wide grep for parser-core:2.3.1 in private repos and image registries, posting findings here within 15m.

security-oncall: Flagged urgent: escalate to legal/comms if we find confirmed upstream successful exploit on production data.

Mira: Thanks team. Quick wins first, then full patch and comms.
